memo:
EdgeHound Performance Review — 2026-06-12

The portfolio is down 13.5% from inception with equity at $8,650 against a $10,000 start. Realized losses of -$1,445 across 19 closed trades (6W/13L, 31.6% win rate) represent a material drawdown requiring immediate attention. The core problem is MOMENTUM: 16 trades, 5 wins (31.3%), -$1,118 PnL. The engine is systematically losing. The Brier score of 0.299 confirms poor probability calibration — the model is not identifying genuine edges; it is predicting ~0.60 for markets that resolve against it at a high rate.

Two structural issues are apparent: (1) MOMENTUM is entering low-liquidity geopolitical markets (US-Iran deals, Strait of Hormuz) where price movements are news-driven and momentum signals are noise, not signal. Seven of 16 MOMENTUM losses share this geopolitical/news cluster. (2) Stakes are too large relative to edge confidence — $800 positions on 31%-win-rate signals is Kelly-negative even at full Kelly. The $800 MOMENTUM losses on Udvardy, Iran ceasefire, and Vitality esports were individually catastrophic relative to bank size.

SMART_CONSENSUS lost $385 on a single large BO3 esports trade — too large for a one-trade sample. SHORT_FAVORITE is the only engine with a positive expected value signal (2 trades, 1 win, +$58) but sample is too small to act on.

Recommendation: Disable SMART_CONSENSUS pending more evidence. Raise pMin to tighten entry quality. Cut kellyMult to reduce position sizing on weak edges. Reduce maxEventExposure to cap catastrophic single-event losses.
observations: MOMENTUM: 16 trades, 31.3% win rate, -$1,118 — primary source of losses, not generating edge
Brier score 0.299 signals systematic miscalibration; predicted ~0.60 consistently vs actual ~0.31 win rate
Seven MOMENTUM losses cluster in geopolitical/news markets (Iran, Hormuz) — signal type is not suited to these markets
SMART_CONSENSUS: 1 trade, -$385 — single large esports bet hit stop loss; sample too small to evaluate but loss is outsized
SHORT_FAVORITE: 2 trades, 1 win, +$58 — only profitable engine; one open position currently offside (Israel airspace NO at entry 0.835, cur 0.9675)
Position sizing too aggressive — $800 stakes on low-confidence signals has amplified losses significantly
Open positions: Israel airspace NO is deep underwater (-16%); SpaceX IPO YES slightly positive; Knicks/Spurs NBA Finals are near-par
VOLUME_SPIKE and ELITE_FOLLOW have zero trades — engines are not triggering or finding opportunities
Equity at $8,650 means we are operating near a 15% drawdown threshold — capital preservation is now a priority
maxEventExposure at $1,000 allowed $800 stakes at current bank size, which is 9.2% of equity per trade — far too large
changeReasoning: Disabling SMART_CONSENSUS: only 1 trade but it entered a $1,000 stake on a speculative esports BO3 and hit stop loss immediately — the signal lacks demonstrated edge and the single large position materially hurt the portfolio. MOMENTUM is retained because disabling our most active engine during a drawdown risks overcorrection on a small sample, but we address its damage through sizing controls. pMin raised from 0.56 to 0.60 to filter weaker entries — the current entry threshold allowed geopolitical trades with shaky fundamentals. kellyMult cut from 0.25 to 0.15 to directly reduce position sizes; at 31% observed win rate, even 0.25 Kelly was over-betting. maxExposure reduced from 0.60 to 0.45 to limit total deployment during this drawdown phase. maxEventExposure cut from $1,000 to $600 to cap any single catastrophic loss — the $800 single-event losses (Udvardy, Vitality, Iran ceasefire) each individually exceeded what a 31% win-rate engine can sustain. VOLUME_SPIKE and ELITE_FOLLOW kept enabled as they generate no trades but provide upside optionality.
riskFlags: Israel airspace NO position (SHORT_FAVORITE, $800 stake) is at 0.9675 vs entry 0.835 — approaching a forced stop; resolution near June 15 deadline warrants monitoring
Knicks YES and Spurs NO are opposing NBA Finals bets on the same event — net exposure may be lower than gross suggests, but confirm no scenario where both lose simultaneously
MOMENTUM engine win rate of 31% over 16 trades is approaching statistical significance for negative edge — if it does not improve to >40% over the next 10 trades, disabling it should be considered
VOLUME_SPIKE and ELITE_FOLLOW have generated zero trades across the entire history — investigate whether they are misconfigured, finding no qualifying markets, or failing silently
Current equity of $8,650 means a further 10% drawdown takes the fund below $7,800 — consider establishing a manual circuit breaker at that level

Geopolitical momentum trades (Iran cluster) show a pattern of rapid adverse price movement post-entry — the bot may be buying into news-driven pumps that reverse quickly; consider filtering by market category if possible
